# Tools Overview

Nutri-MCP exposes **38 tools** (plus `estimateNutritionFromText` when Nutritionix is configured). All tools are read-only and return both `structuredContent` (validated against an `outputSchema`) and a JSON text block.

| Category | Tool | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| [Product](./product.md) | [`getProductByBarcode`](./product.md#getproductbybarcode) | Get the full product record for a barcode: name, brand, nutrients per 100 g (and per serving), Nutri-Score, Green-Score, NOVA group, ingredients, allergens and additives |
| [Product](./product.md) | [`searchProducts`](./product.md#searchproducts) | Search food products by text, brand and/or category, optionally limited to a maximum Nutri-Score grade or NOVA group |
| [Nutrition](./nutrition.md) | [`analyzeNutrition`](./nutrition.md#analyzenutrition) | Complete nutritional analysis of a product per 100 g: calories, macro split, % Daily Values, UK FSA traffic lights, concerns (high fat/saturates/sugars/salt) and benefits (good/excellent sources) |
| [Nutrition](./nutrition.md) | [`getNutriScore`](./nutrition.md#getnutriscore) | Get the Nutri-Score grade (A-E) with its points breakdown (2023 algorithm when available: negative points for energy, sugars, saturated fat, salt; positive points for fiber, protein, fruits/vegetables/legumes) |
| [Nutrition](./nutrition.md) | [`getGreenScore`](./nutrition.md#getgreenscore) | Get the Green-Score (formerly Eco-Score) environmental impact grade (A+ best to F worst) and score, from Open Food Facts life-cycle analysis |
| [Nutrition](./nutrition.md) | [`calculateDailyIntake`](./nutrition.md#calculatedailyintake) | Nutrients and % Daily Values for a given number of servings (uses the labelled serving size, or `grams` when given) |
| [Nutrition](./nutrition.md) | [`getMacroBreakdown`](./nutrition.md#getmacrobreakdown) | Macronutrient breakdown per 100 g: grams, calories and share of energy from protein, carbohydrates and fat |
| [Nutrition](./nutrition.md) | [`getNutrientDensity`](./nutrition.md#getnutrientdensity) | Nutrient density score: sum of % Daily Value of beneficial nutrients (fiber, protein, vitamins, minerals) per 100 kcal |
| [Nutrition](./nutrition.md) | [`analyzeMeal`](./nutrition.md#analyzemeal) | Combined nutrition of several products eaten together |
| [Nutrition](./nutrition.md) | [`getNovaGroup`](./nutrition.md#getnovagroup) | NOVA food processing classification (1 = unprocessed ... 4 = ultra-processed) for a product |
| [Allergen & Diet](./allergen.md) | [`checkAllergen`](./allergen.md#checkallergen) | Check whether a product contains (or may contain traces of) a specific allergen |
| [Allergen & Diet](./allergen.md) | [`checkMultipleAllergens`](./allergen.md#checkmultipleallergens) | Check a product against a list of allergens at once |
| [Allergen & Diet](./allergen.md) | [`checkBig9`](./allergen.md#checkbig9) | Check a product against the US FDA "Big 9" major allergens (milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame) |
| [Allergen & Diet](./allergen.md) | [`checkEU14`](./allergen.md#checkeu14) | Check a product against the 14 major allergens of EU Regulation 1169/2011 |
| [Allergen & Diet](./allergen.md) | [`getAllAllergens`](./allergen.md#getallallergens) | List every allergen declared for a product: confirmed, "may contain" and traces |
| [Allergen & Diet](./allergen.md) | [`getCrossContaminationRisk`](./allergen.md#getcrosscontaminationrisk) | Assess cross-contamination risk from trace declarations and "may contain" / shared-facility warnings on the label |
| [Allergen & Diet](./allergen.md) | [`checkDietCompliance`](./allergen.md#checkdietcompliance) | Check whether a product fits a diet (vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, keto, paleo, gluten_free, dairy_free, low_sodium, low_sugar, halal, kosher) |
| [Allergen & Diet](./allergen.md) | [`getAdditivesInfo`](./allergen.md#getadditivesinfo) | Additives (E-numbers) in a product with names, functions (e.g. emulsifier, preservative) and EFSA over-exposure risk |
| [Comparison](./comparison.md) | [`compareProducts`](./comparison.md#compareproducts) | Compare 2-5 products side by side (Nutri-Score, Green-Score, NOVA and key nutrients per 100 g) and pick the healthier option |
| [Comparison](./comparison.md) | [`findHealthierAlternative`](./comparison.md#findhealthieralternative) | Find a healthier alternative to a product (better Nutri-Score, less processed, less salt/sugar/saturated fat, more fiber/protein) |
| [Comparison](./comparison.md) | [`compareNutrientDensity`](./comparison.md#comparenutrientdensity) | Rank products by nutrient density (% Daily Value of beneficial nutrients per 100 kcal) |
| [Comparison](./comparison.md) | [`rankByNutrient`](./comparison.md#rankbynutrient) | Rank products by one nutrient per 100 g (e.g. highest protein, lowest sugars) |
| [Price](./price.md) | [`getProductPrices`](./price.md#getproductprices) | Most recent crowdsourced prices for a product (newest first), with store and location |
| [Price](./price.md) | [`searchPrices`](./price.md#searchprices) | Search crowdsourced prices by product, currency, country, date and discount status |
| [Price](./price.md) | [`getPriceStats`](./price.md#getpricestats) | Min, max, average, median and latest price for a product, computed separately for each currency |
| [Price](./price.md) | [`findBestPrice`](./price.md#findbestprice) | Lowest recent price for a product in each currency, with the store where it was seen |
| [Price](./price.md) | [`comparePrices`](./price.md#compareprices) | Compare median and best prices of several products in one currency, including price per kg/L to find the best value |
| [Price](./price.md) | [`getRecentPrices`](./price.md#getrecentprices) | Prices most recently added by the Open Prices community, optionally filtered by currency or country |
| [Price](./price.md) | [`getPriceHistory`](./price.md#getpricehistory) | Monthly median price of a product over the last months, per currency, to spot price trends |
| [Price](./price.md) | [`findDeals`](./price.md#finddeals) | Recently reported discounted prices (promotions), optionally for one product, currency or country |
| [Recipe & Meal](./recipe.md) | [`suggestRecipes`](./recipe.md#suggestrecipes) | Recipe ideas that use a product, based on its categories, plus whether the product itself fits the requested diets |
| [Recipe & Meal](./recipe.md) | [`substituteIngredient`](./recipe.md#substituteingredient) | Common substitutes for an ingredient (butter, egg, milk, cream, cheese, flour, sugar, honey, gelatin, soy sauce, breadcrumbs), filterable by need |
| [Recipe & Meal](./recipe.md) | [`analyzeMealPlan`](./recipe.md#analyzemealplan) | Calories and macros per meal and for the whole day |
| [Recipe & Meal](./recipe.md) | [`calculateMealCost`](./recipe.md#calculatemealcost) | Estimated cost of a meal from crowdsourced median prices in one currency |
| [Insights](./insights.md) | [`getProductInsights`](./insights.md#getproductinsights) | Machine-learning predictions about a product from Open Food Facts Robotoff (e.g. suggested categories, labels, brands) that are not yet confirmed |
| [Insights](./insights.md) | [`getAIQuestions`](./insights.md#getaiquestions) | Yes/no questions generated by Robotoff that need human verification, for one product or random products |
| [Insights](./insights.md) | [`qualityCheck`](./insights.md#qualitycheck) | Check how complete the data for a product is (nutrients, scores, ingredients, allergens, images) and what is missing |
| [Safety](./safety.md) | [`checkRecalls`](./safety.md#checkrecalls) | Search US FDA food recall / enforcement reports (openFDA) by barcode and/or product text |
